page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It also lacks integrated GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6t.2xlarge offers a standard resource density suitable for mainstream enterprise applications that require dedicated CPU resources without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or compute-optimized hardware. The balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance appropriate for general-purpose workloads, including mid-sized web servers, application hosting, containerized microservices, and development environments.
